description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecHostRequestEvaluator component, validating its request validation and decision-making logic related to execution host requests in a security context.

classes.name: ExecHostRequestEvaluatorTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing various test cases to verify the behavior of ExecHostRequestEvaluator.

methods.name: `validate request rejects empty command`
methods.description: Tests that an empty command in ExecHostRequest results in a validation failure with appropriate error.

methods.name: `evaluate requires prompt on allowlist miss without decision`
methods.description: Tests that evaluate() prompts for approval when allowlist is not satisfied and no previous decision is made.

methods.name: `evaluate allows allow once decision on allowlist miss`
methods.description: Tests that allowOnce decision allows execution even if allowlist is not satisfied.

methods.name: `evaluate denies on explicit deny decision`
methods.description: Tests that an explicit deny decision results in a denial regardless of allowlist satisfaction.
